BA plan step 4: cp -r ${WORKTREE}/packages/happy-cli/dist/* /root/happy-dev/packages/happy-cli/dist/

This IS correct: systemctl cat happy-daemon-dev.service shows ExecStart=/usr/bin/happy-dev daemon start; /usr/bin/happy-dev resolves via symlink to /root/happy-dev/packages/happy-cli/bin/happy-dev.mjs, which loads '../dist/index.mjs' relative to that, i.e. /root/happy-dev/packages/happy-cli/dist/index.mjs.

/root/happy-dev is itself a symlink to /dev/shm/dev-workspace/happy-dev (the monorepo parent of the worktree). Therefore BA's copy operation writes into the PARENT monorepo's dist directory, which is where the running daemon actually loads from (verified in `ps` output: /dev/shm/dev-workspace/happy-dev/packages/happy-cli/dist/index.mjs).

Verified running process: daemon Main PID 400414 exec line shows 'node --no-warnings --no-deprecation /dev/shm/dev-workspace/happy-dev/packages/happy-cli/dist/index.mjs daemon start-sync' — confirming the copy target is correct.

Note (minor, not an objection): BA's wording at line 191 treats /root/happy-dev as a distinct tree from the worktree, without acknowledging that it is a symlink to the monorepo parent. A dev executing the plan will see that /root/happy-dev IS /dev/shm/dev-workspace/happy-dev and may worry the copy is a no-op. It is NOT — the worktree (under .claude/worktrees/overnight-20260424-bfbc5f54) has its own packages/happy-cli/dist separate from the parent's packages/happy-cli/dist. Copy from worktree-dist to parent-dist is required and correct. Recommend BA clarify this in a dev comment but this is not a blocker.
